race.title: StoneX Commodities Conditional Jockeys' Handicap Hurdle
race.verdict: Hard to discount any in a tight-looking handicap. KAMAXOS is interesting in this sort of grade and may add another winner to Charlie Longsdon's recent haul. Maccarellu is potentially well treated if back on song, with Western Cross also appealing at the weights. KAMAXOS (FR) MACCARELLU (FR) WESTERN CROSS (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Western Cross (11/10), Only One Blue (8/1), Bridge (8/1), Kamaxos (17/2), The Sainted Canary (17/2), Marhaba Prince (9/1), Maccarellu (10/1), Belfrina (18/1)
